findings.title: Administrative Service Exposed (SMB File Sharing)
findings.description: Administrative access interface SMB File Sharing detected listening on TCP/445.
findings.impact: Exposed administration endpoints are frequent targets of brute-force password guessing and lateral movement attacks.
findings.recommendation: Enforce Network Level Authentication (NLA), place administration behind a dedicated VPN / bastion host, and restrict firewall access rules.
